beliefs: f is exactly flat at -22.8021 for x in [-7.25, 5.75] [E3, E4, E5, E6]
The right edge of the plateau is between 5.75 and 5.8; f(5.75)=-22.8021 and f(5.8)=-22.6269 begins the ramp [E4, E6]
The right transition is a linear ramp from x=5.8 to x=8.0 with slope ~70.37 per unit (f(5.8)=-22.6269 to f(8)=132.1905) [E4, E6]
The left transition is a linear ramp from x=-8.0 to x=-7.25 with slope ~-59.5 per unit (f(-8)=21.8213 to f(-7.25)=-22.8021) [E5]

Outside the transition bands f is a single quadratic a*x^2+b*x+c; fitting E10's far-field points gives a~3.088, b~-2.5, c~-22.8, but residuals grow with |x| suggesting mild higher-order terms [E1, E2, E7, E8, E9, E10]
The quadratic under-predicts mid-range and far-field (e.g. f(16)=857.05 vs 727.7; f(-127)=50632 vs 50101), so the MLP's quadratic has extra curvature beyond a*x^2+b*x+c [E1, E2, E9]
